capabilities: Search the vault with match case, whole word, regex, and multiline toggles
Replace matches using capture-group tokens like $1 with live previews
Filter searches with include and exclude rules by extension, folder, or wildcard
Replace single matches, selected matches, whole files, or the entire vault
Jump from a result to its location in the editor
extras: The README warns that replacements cannot be undone from inside the plugin and recommends backing up or committing the vault to git before large replacements. A separate User guide covers filters, regex, multiline search, and settings.
problem: Obsidian can search the vault but has no built-in way to review matches and replace them across files from one view.

relations.evidence: Vault-wide find and replace for Obsidian, modeled on the VSCode search sidebar

summary: Vault-wide find and replace sidebar modeled on the VSCode search view, with regex capture tokens, file filters, and selective replacement.
